howto.name: Paste JSON
howto.text: Drop valid JSON into the left textarea.

howto.name: Read YAML instantly
howto.text: Clean YAML with proper indentation appears on the right, ready to paste into a Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Compose file. Click Copy to grab it. Pure-browser conversion.

faq.a: Yes. The JSON never leaves your device — pure-browser conversion, no upload.

faq.q: Will it format the YAML correctly?
faq.a: Yes — proper indentation (2 spaces), keys with special characters get quoted, lists get the bullet-point style by default. Output is ready to paste into a Kubernetes or GitHub Actions file.

faq.q: What if the JSON is invalid?
faq.a: An error appears in the output area. Fix the JSON and the conversion updates live.
